body: This has potential for messing with user scripts, if they expect wheel transforms to be local.

I didn't think of that .. Hmm, we might be able to use local space when sending to server although it will be a bit more expensive. I'll take a look.

(On the other hand, this seems kind of unlikely, they'd more likely be grabbing the global xform of the wheel if using it..) :thinking:

Wasn't aware of the function, but on looking, that version adds `0.0f` for the sign of zero, which is unnecessary here.

We could add a version of the function that doesn't do that (it seems for gdscript use), but probably for another PR.
OK, should be in local space now. Still not sure it's worth it but...
